as_told.title: Detlev Bronk's alien autopsies after the Aztec and Roswell crashes
as_told.place_text: Aztec, New Mexico; Roswell, New Mexico

plain: Jesse Michels says that Detlev Bronk, who went on to run the Rockefeller Foundation and to serve as president of Johns Hopkins, was once in charge of "quote unquote alien autopsies", meaning the examination of bodies said to come from crashed saucers. Michels tells it himself in two episodes. In the later one he says Bronk was "supposedly" doing this work on bodies from the Aztec crash, a saucer crash said to have happened in New Mexico in 1948, and "maybe" from Roswell, the most famous claimed crash, in New Mexico in 1947. His source there is the MJ-12 documents, papers describing a secret top-level group said to have handled crashed saucers, and if he is right a leading American scientist examined non-human bodies.
